clear_drop_clear.zh: {bench}明显下跌，{clear}明显走强，起到了避险作用。
clear_drop_clear.en: {bench} fell sharply while {clear} rose clearly. {clear_verb} as a safe haven.

small_drop_clear.zh: {bench}小幅下跌，{clear}明显走强，起到了一定的避险作用。
small_drop_clear.en: {bench} fell modestly while {clear} rose clearly. {clear_verb} as a partial safe haven.

drop_lean_many.zh: {bench}下跌，{lean}走强，但幅度不足以排除偶然。
drop_lean_many.en: {bench} fell and {lean} rose, but not by enough to rule out chance.

drop_lean_one.zh: {bench}下跌，{lean}走强，但幅度不足以排除偶然。
drop_lean_one.en: {bench} fell and {lean} rose, but not by enough to rule out chance.

drop_none.zh: {bench}下跌，但没有资产明显走强，这次看不到避险效果。
drop_none.en: {bench} fell, but no asset rose clearly. No safe-haven effect shows up this time.

no_drop.zh: {bench}没有下跌，这次不构成避险考验。
no_drop.en: {bench} did not fall, so this was not a safe-haven test.

incomplete.zh: 一个月的窗口还没结束，先不下结论。
incomplete.en: The one-month window is still open, so there is no verdict yet.

no_bench.zh: {bench}在这段时间没有数据，无法判断。
no_bench.en: {bench} has no data for this period, so there is no verdict.

pressure.zh: 事件后 30 天的地缘风险指数均值为 {gpr}，高于过去十年里 {pct}% 的时候，属于{state}水平。
pressure.en: The geopolitical risk index averaged {gpr} over the 30 days after the date, higher than {pct}% of the past ten years. That is {state}.

pressure_insufficient.zh: 这段时间的地缘风险指数数据不足，无法判断压力水平。
pressure_insufficient.en: There is not enough geopolitical risk data for this period to judge the pressure level.

history_row.zh: 在 {n} 个内置事件里，{asset}明显走强 {clear} 次、偏强 {lean} 次，一个月收益中位数 {median}%。
history_row.en: Across {n} built-in events, {asset} rose clearly {clear} times and somewhat {lean} times. Its median one-month return was {median}%.

history_none.zh: {asset}在内置事件里没有可评级的窗口。
history_none.en: {asset} has no rated window among the built-in events.

evidence.zh: 证据等级：{grade}。等级只说明这次走势在历史上有多少见，不说明原因。
evidence.en: Evidence: {grade}. The grade says how unusual the moves were, not why they happened.

pressure_latest.zh: 最近 30 天的地缘风险指数均值为 {gpr}，高于过去十年里 {pct}% 的时候，属于{state}水平。
pressure_latest.en: The geopolitical risk index averaged {gpr} over the last 30 days, higher than {pct}% of the past ten years. That is {state}.

no_forecast.zh: 本站预先登记的样本外检验没有通过。历史对照只描述过去，不构成预测。
no_forecast.en: This site's pre-registered out-of-sample test did not pass. The historical comparison describes the past and is not a forecast.

hindsight_preset.zh: 内置事件的日期是看过行情之后挑的，结果会偏乐观。
hindsight_preset.en: The built-in dates were picked after the prices were known, so results lean optimistic.

hindsight_custom.zh: 如果这个日期是看过行情之后挑的，结果会偏乐观。
hindsight_custom.en: If you picked this date after seeing the prices, the results lean optimistic.

multi.zh: 同时看了 {k} 个资产，偶然有一个冲到前列的机会更大，所以「明显走强」的门槛已收紧到历史上最强的 {top}%。
multi.en: {k} assets were checked at once, which raises the chance that one stands out by luck. The bar for clearly stronger is raised to the strongest {top}% of past moves.

incomplete.zh: 一个月的窗口还没结束，数字会继续变。
incomplete.en: The one-month window is still open, so the numbers will keep changing.

unrated.zh: {assets}因为历史太短或缺数据没有评级。
unrated.en: {assets} could not be rated because of short history or missing data.

futures.zh: {assets}用的是连续期货，换月日可能出现跳变。
futures.en: {assets} use continuous futures, which can jump on roll dates.

gpr_lag.zh: 地缘风险指数的数据止于 {last}，早于窗口结束。
gpr_lag.en: Geopolitical risk data end on {last}, before the window closes.

no_test.zh: {bench}没有下跌，资产走强不能说明避险作用。
no_test.en: {bench} did not fall, so rising assets do not show a safe-haven role.

weaker.zh: 弱于历史上 {x}% 的一个月走势
weaker.en: weaker than {x}% of its past one-month moves

stronger.zh: 强于历史上 {x}% 的一个月走势
stronger.en: stronger than {x}% of its past one-month moves

headline_down_tail.zh: {down}也明显下跌，没有起到避险作用。
headline_down_tail.en_one: {down} also fell clearly and did not act as a safe haven.
headline_down_tail.en_many: {down} also fell clearly and did not act as safe havens.
